gizmo.title: Funso Lofananitsa
gizmo.description: Ntchito yokoka ndi kuponya yofananitsa mafunso ndi mayankho ake olondola.

configure.title: Funso
configure.description: Funso kwa ogwiritsa ntchito. Lembani malo oponyera, kenako lembani mayankho mpaka malo otsatira.

advanced.title: Yopindika
advanced.description: Onetsani funso ili ngati mzere womwe umatsegulidwa ndi kutsekedwa. Kutsegula limodzi kumatseka mafunso ena opindika oyandikana nalo.

advanced.title: Yambani yopindidwa
advanced.description: Ikapindika, yambani ngati mzere wotsekedwa womwe umangowonetsa funso ndi momwe lilili.

advanced.title: Njira yopatsira maksi
advanced.description: OER Schema: njira yopatsira maksi pa mayeso awa (mwachitsanzo mfundo, chilembo, peresenti, kumaliza).

advanced.title: Cholinga cha maphunziro
advanced.description: OER Schema: cholinga cha maphunziro chokhudzana ndi mayeso awa.

developer.title: Dzina la mayeso
developer.description: Dzina la mayeso logwiritsidwa ntchito pozindikira mu xAPI m'machitidwe owunika.

developer.title: Maphunziro
developer.description: OER Schema: maphunziro omwe mayeso awa akukonzedwera.
